scope: Model/editor semantic and pedagogy review of Lesson 0125; not an independent human or real-learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: Target-bearing learner lines ‘Yes. This information is for you.’ and ‘This information is for Maya too.’ are grammatical and natural; all English distractors were individually checked for naturalness.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: Persian copy consistently maps information to «اطلاعات» and preserves the intended meaning across dialogue and activities.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: The lexical target is recognized, then the dialogue is exposed before dependent listening/transfer work, followed by hidden-answer retrieval.

distractorQuality.evidence: A04 and A05 use grammatical, natural alternatives with explicit model audit evidence and a concrete semantic contrast for every wrong option.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: لیو و لیام در کتابخانه برگه اطلاعات یک برنامه را می‌بینند و لیام می‌گوید اطلاعات برای چه کسی است.

difficultyFit.evidence: Learner production stays short and controlled; one lexical target is scored and the familiar present-be affirmative frame is recycled explicitly.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: information recurs across recognition, guided speech, comprehension, transfer, and hidden retrieval without adding another scored lexical target.

transferQuality.evidence: The second learner response changes the recipient while preserving the same bounded sense of information.

overallCoherence.evidence: Outcome, construction, scenario, learner turns, choices, grammar recycling, and final retrieval align to the same objective.

learnerExperience.evidence: Runtime order was audited so dependent listening follows dialogue exposure; no real learner test is claimed, so pacing and difficulty remain unverified.

runtimeAssetGrounding.evidence: No image/photo/visual is claimed. Listening and dialogue playback reference only T01–T04, all marked audioRequired=true.

limitations: No independent human or real learner test has been performed.
Only the bounded lexical sense defined for this Lesson is reviewed.
Generated audio pronunciation/prosody is not evaluated at this text stage.
resolvedFindings: English turns, accepted speech strings, and every English distractor were checked for grammar, naturalness, and internal consistency.
Persian orthography, نیم‌فاصله usage where applicable, and English–Persian meaning consistency were checked.
Reference key, part of speech, sense key, and provisional spec hash were cross-checked against the worker packet.
CEFRJ-GRAM-58 is recycled only where the present-be affirmative frame is actually present.
Learner-context dependency order was checked: A02 exposes T01–T04 before A03 relies on T01–T02, and A06 retrieves an already exposed T04 response.
No unsupported visual claim exists; all listening sources are audio-required turns.
Final retrieval keeps the answer hidden before attempt.
Story arc returns after 5 Lessons and the learner role changes from the prior scene.

Target collocation coverage was repaired with explicit compatible fallbacks for the normalized windows ‘have the information’ and ‘yes this information is for’; no corpus evidence or human testing is invented.
